knowledge.name: Bundled synthetic loyalty records
knowledge.detail: Fixed member, points, spend, engagement, tier, reward-catalog, preference, and earning records support deterministic review.

knowledge.name: Rules and safety knowledge
knowledge.detail: Uploaded rules define persona routing, exact evidence anchors, synthetic labels, identifier handling, and prohibited side effects.

knowledge.name: Approved catalog architecture
knowledge.detail: The curated one-pager names loyalty, CRM, marketing personas and Microsoft systems; it does not prove live connections.

intelligence_processing.name: Program health and liability analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Aggregates synthetic members, outstanding points, illustrative point value, spend, engagement, and tier distribution.

intelligence_processing.name: Informational points analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Explains synthetic balance, earned and redeemed totals, multiplier, illustrative value, and earning opportunities.

intelligence_processing.name: Review-only reward matching
intelligence_processing.detail: Matches broad synthetic preferences and available balances to catalog options without creating offers or issuing benefits.

intelligence_processing.name: Tier structure and progress analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares thresholds, multipliers, perks, spend progress, remaining spend, and structural tradeoffs without changing status.

intelligence_processing.name: Persona-aligned request routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Routes program, ledger, reward-option, and tier questions for Loyalty Program Director, CRM Manager, or Marketing Leader.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language access through validated Draft agents with four skills, two knowledge files, and no configured tools.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file RAPP agent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints with synthetic-only operation routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Role-focused review responses
clients_user_interface.detail: Presents evidence-first outputs for loyalty, CRM, and marketing reviewers with an explicit no-side-effect notice.

management_reporting.name: Synthetic Loyalty Program Dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports member count, outstanding points and value, spend, engagement, tenure, and tier distribution for governance review.

management_reporting.name: Synthetic Points Summary
management_reporting.detail: Reports tier, balance, illustrative value, earned and redeemed points, multiplier, and fixed earning examples.

management_reporting.name: Draft Reward Option Recommendations
management_reporting.detail: Reports preference-matched catalog options and point costs as review-only concepts, not issued offers or rewards.

management_reporting.name: Synthetic Tier Analysis
management_reporting.detail: Reports tier thresholds, multipliers, key perks, member progress, remaining spend, and top-tier status.

tools.name: Portable CustomerLoyaltyRewardsAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file BasicAgent exposes four deterministic read-only operations using bundled synthetic data and no credentials.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the four-skill conversational package; validated agents remain Draft and require explicit approval before publish.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 CRM
tools.detail: Named by the approved catalog and deployment seam for consented CRM context; no live connector is configured.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 ERP
tools.detail: Named by the approved catalog as a potential enterprise record seam; the synthetic package does not connect to it.

tools.name: Microsoft Outlook
tools.detail: Named by the approved catalog as a review or communication surface; the agent never sends or schedules outreach.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Named by the approved catalog as a collaboration surface; no message, approval, task, or member action is configured.

tools.name: Approved read-only loyalty ledger
tools.detail: Documented production seam for authorized balance context; current demonstrations use fixed synthetic records only.

tools.name: Authorized rewards workflow
tools.detail: Documented action seam requiring authentication, authorization, human approval, and audit; local demos perform no writes.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence enforcement
supporting_features.detail: Rejects non-synthetic data_source values, validates member IDs, and forbids browsing, enrichment, or invented records.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes loyalty dashboard, points summary, reward recommendations, and tier analysis from natural-language intent.

supporting_features.name: Explicit no-side-effect boundary
supporting_features.detail: Prohibits contact, enrollment, points or tier changes, offers, rewards, redemption, refunds, orders, and purchases.

supporting_features.name: Human authorization and approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Production writes require authenticated tools, authorization checks, explicit human approval, and audit logging.

supporting_features.name: Persona and identifier controls
supporting_features.detail: Limits framing to three approved personas and stops on unknown synthetic member identifiers instead of approximating.

supporting_features.name: Locked case and isolation validation
supporting_features.detail: Records four passing persona-language cases with required evidence anchors and only the expected RAPP tool loaded.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Keeps validated Copilot Studio agents unpublished and makes publication a separate confirmation step.
